items.text: 黛玉冷笑道：「我就知道，別人不挑剩下的也不給我。」
items.answer: Daiyu gave a cold laugh. "I knew it. Unless others have passed these over, I'm not given anything."

errors.evidence: I'm not given anything.
errors.why: It generalizes the remark to 'anything' instead of the flowers, and the 'unless... passed over' phrasing is slightly looser than 'what others didn't pick and left'.

errors.why: It generalizes the remark about these particular flowers into a statement about everything, and weakens the sense that she gets only what others rejected.

items.text: 賈母道：「讀的是什麼書，不過是認得兩個字，不是睜眼的瞎子罷了！」
items.answer: Grandmother Jia said, "What books? They only know a few characters. They're not blind, at least."

errors.evidence: They're not blind, at least.
errors.why: The idiom 睜眼的瞎子 means 'illiterate person'. The candidate reads it as literal blindness, so the point (barely literate) is lost, though the minimizing tone survives.

items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: Feng Jie said, "I have been telling you all day long that you are too soft. If you let the household servants get this out of hand, how can it end well?"

errors.evidence: Feng Jie said
errors.why: 鳳姐 is rendered as 'Feng Jie' (treating 姐 as a name part) rather than the standard Xifeng / Sister Feng, which would be more familiar to readers.

items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: Phoenix said, "I have been telling you all day long that you are far too soft. If you let the household servants get this out of hand, what will become of us?"

errors.evidence: Phoenix said
errors.why: 鳳姐 is Xifeng; 'Phoenix' is a translation of the nickname without explanation, and it departs from the name the reader knows.

errors.evidence: I have been telling you all day long
errors.why: 成日家 means 'constantly, all the time', not literally 'all day long' in one stretch. The sense is close, but it suggests a single day rather than habitual nagging.

errors.evidence: what will become of us?
errors.why: 還了得了 means 'this is intolerable, how can it be allowed'. The candidate renders it as a question about the consequences, which is close but loses the outrage.

items.text: 鳳姐道：「我成日家說你太軟弱了，縱的家裡人這樣還了得了。」
items.answer: Feng Jie said, "I have been telling you all day long that you are too soft. If you let the household people act like this, how can things ever be right?"

errors.evidence: how can things ever be right?

errors.evidence: the household people
errors.why: Unnatural phrase for 家裡人; 'servants' or 'household staff' would be clearer.

errors.evidence: Feng Jie
errors.why: Uses the form 'Feng Jie' rather than the standard 'Xifeng' or 'Sister Feng'; it is understandable but not the conventional form.

errors.why: 命根子 (life-root, his very lifeline) is flattened to a generic 'precious jewel', losing the sense that the jade is his lifeblood.

items.text: 寶玉未及回言，只見舡頭上來了兩人，一僧一道，夾住寶玉說道：「俗緣已畢，還不快走。」

errors.evidence: Why are you still not leaving?
errors.why: 還不快走 is an urging to leave quickly; the candidate renders it as a plain question and drops 快 (quickly).

errors.evidence: They pinned Baoyu between them
errors.why: 'Pinned' suggests a forceful or hostile grip, whereas 夾住 means they flanked him.

items.answer: On the terrace steps sat several maids in red and green. As soon as they saw the newcomers, they hurried down smiling to greet them and said, "The old lady was just speaking of her, and here she is, just in time."

errors.evidence: "The old lady was just speaking of her, and here she is

items.text: 祖師聞言，咄的一聲，跳下高臺，手持戒尺，指定悟空道：「你這猢猻，這般不學，那般不學，卻待怎麼？」
items.answer: The Patriarch heard this, let out a sharp "Hah!", jumped down from the high platform, took up his teaching ruler, pointed at Wukong, and said, "You little monkey, you won't study this and you won't study that. What do you want to do?"

errors.evidence: took up his teaching ruler
errors.why: 戒尺 is a disciplinary ruler or rod, and "teaching ruler" blurs the sense of punishment.

errors.evidence: "Hah!"
errors.why: 咄 is an angry rebuke like "Tut!", and "Hah!" could read as laughter.

items.text: 祖師聞言，咄的一聲，跳下高臺，手持戒尺，指定悟空道：「你這猢猻，這般不學，那般不學，卻待怎麼？」
items.answer: The Patriarch heard this, gave a sharp "Hmph!", jumped down from the high platform, took up a teacher's ruler, pointed at Wukong, and said, "You little monkey, you won't learn this and you won't learn that. What do you want to do?"

errors.evidence: You little monkey

errors.evidence: You little monkey

items.text: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。
items.answer: This monkey king was also the kind who, once one opening was clear, all the others were clear too. He learned the oral formula at once, practiced and refined it on his own, and mastered all seventy-two transformations.

errors.evidence: the kind who, once one opening was clear, all the others were clear too
errors.why: The sentence is grammatically awkward, and 'opening was clear' is vague for the proverb, though the sense of quick comprehension is mostly conveyed.

items.text: 這猴王也是他一竅通時百竅通，當時習了口訣，自修自煉，將七十二般變化都學成了。
